responsibility: Out-of-line implementation of the Objective-C front end’s lightweight GGC-managed hash map. It provides allocation, load-factor tuning, power-of-two sizing, and table-resize/rehash support for the open-addressed identifier-to-tree maps declared in objc-map.h, which back semantic registries such as selector, method, and class-name lookup tables used throughout the ObjC front end.
same_name_distinction: Out-of-line implementation side of the objc-map pair: this .c file provides allocation, capacity normalization, load-factor control, resizing, and rehashing for the GGC-managed open-addressed map. Unlike gcc/objc/objc-map.h, it does not define the includable map type and inline lookup/insertion/iteration API used across the front end.
